author: St. Thomas More
name: The Answer to a Poisoned Book
name_pt: A Resposta a um Livro Envenenado
desc: More's last published polemic (1533), against the Supper of the Lord, an anonymous attack on the Real Presence, defending the doctrine of the Eucharist.
desc_pt: A última polêmica publicada de More (1533), contra A Ceia do Senhor, ataque anônimo à Presença Real, em defesa da doutrina eucarística.
edition: The answere to the fyrst parte of the poysened booke (London: 1533), EEBO-TCP A07690.
